messages.text:
"Create a complete, playable horror game for mobile from scratch, in a single HTML file (HTML + CSS + JavaScript, no external libraries, no external images or audio files).

CONCEPT
- 2D top-down view inside an abandoned house at night.
- The player has a flashlight with a light cone and limited battery. Everything outside the light is nearly black.
- Goal: find 5 keys scattered across the rooms, then reach the exit door.
- A monster patrols the house, hunts the player when it hears or sees them, and kills on contact.

MOBILE CONTROLS (portrait)
- Virtual joystick on the left to move.
- \"Run\" button on the right (uses stamina, makes more noise).
- Flashlight on/off button.
- Interact button for picking up keys, opening doors, and hiding.
- No keyboard required. Prevent page scrolling and zooming, and support multi-touch.

MECHANICS
- Monster AI states: patrol, suspicious (investigates the last noise), chase, search (loses the player and sweeps the area).
- Noise system: running, knocking over objects, and slamming doors attract the monster.
- Hiding spots (closets, beds): the monster can check them randomly.
- Batteries scattered around to recharge the flashlight.
- Flickering light and a heartbeat effect that speeds up as the monster gets closer.
- Locked doors that require specific keys.

AUDIO AND ATMOSPHERE
- Generate all sounds with the Web Audio API: footsteps, heartbeat, ambient drone, monster growl, jump scare sting.
- Vignette, film grain, screen shake when the monster is near.
- Subtle haptic feedback via navigator.vibrate where supported.

GAME FLOW
- Title screen, short intro text, gameplay, game over screen with retry, and a win screen.
- Simple HUD: keys collected, battery, stamina.
- Procedurally generated house layout so each run is different.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Canvas-based rendering at 60 FPS, responsive to any phone screen size.
- Clean, commented, well-structured code split into logical sections (input, AI, rendering, audio, game state).
- Must run offline by opening the file directly in a mobile browser.
- Test the logic mentally for bugs before outputting: no softlocks, the monster never spawns on the player, all 5 keys always reachable.

Output only the full code in one code block, followed by a 3-line summary of how to play.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
